name: ADC, ACC, CHC, HSC, HRC, PC, and TPC Special Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
Architectural and Design Review Commission, Arts and Culture
  Commission, Cultural Heritage Commission, Health and Safety
Commission, Human Relations Commission, Planning Commission, Public
 Works Commission, Recreation and Parks Commission, and Traffic and
Parking Commission will conduct a Special Meeting, at the following time
  and place, and will address the agenda listed below:

  CITY HALL
  455 North Rexford Drive
  City Council Chambers
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Thursday, October 30, 2025
  6:00 PM

  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA

  1) Welcome by Mayor Sharona R. Nazarian, PsyD

  2) Pledge of Allegiance

  3) RoIl Call of Each Commission

  4) Public Comment
  a. Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly
  address the Commissions on any item listed on the agenda.

  5) Training
  • Comments from City Manager Nancy Hunt-Coffey
  • Role of Commissons and Commissioners
  • Behaviors of High Performing Commissions
  • Media and Camera Ready
  • Legal and Procedural Issues
  • Closing Comments from Assistant City Manager Ryan Gohlich

  6) Adjournment of Each Commission

Huma Ahmed, City Clerk

Posted: October 27, 2025

  Pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, the City of Beverly Hills will make
  reasonable efforts to accommodate persons with disabilities. If you require special
 assistance, please call (310) 285-1014 (voice) or (310) 285-6881 (TTY). Providing at
 least twenty-four (24) hours advance notice will help to ensure availability of services.
  City Hall, including the Municipal Gallery, is wheelchair accessible.
